sequences.name: security-controls
sequences.notes: #45 is three slices in three packages (platform guards, matter item state, sandcastle providers) and #53 is three findings in matter/core/react-router: matter/systems/server/item/itemManager.ts is edited by both, so they are serialized in this batch rather than run as two lanes. Order #45 -> #53 because 45's item slice establishes the mutation module that 53's tick-abort finding then edits. Landed as separate commits but one integration, so the shared file cannot conflict.
sequences.title: security: testable controls

sequences.name: sandcastle-tooling
sequences.notes: All three edit packages/sandcastle/src/queue/ but on distinct files: #38 queue/manifest.ts (version-tolerant read), #33 queue/commands.ts + queue/ops.ts + main.ts + cli.ts (injected context), #60 queue/graph.ts + queue/render.ts (parallel lanes). In-batch order is #38 -> #33 -> #60 because #33 rewrites the two modules every subcommand flows through, and #60's graph render must go through the context #33 introduces rather than re-deriving it. No shared file, so no R-rule is needed against the other batches except where noted.
sequences.title: sandcastle: queue tooling

sequences.name: sandcastle-containment
sequences.notes: Both edit packages/sandcastle/src/git.ts and worktree.ts: #47 routes the destructive spawns (worktree.ts rmdir via cmd.exe, git.ts baseRef) through one containment/child-process seam, and #41 adds signing verification to the commit path in git.ts plus the three commit call sites (issue.ts, queue/persist.ts, integration/merger.ts). Serialized in this batch because of the shared files. #47 first: it establishes the seam #41's commit path should then use, rather than #41 teaching the old shape to verify signatures and #47 rewriting it. This batch also overlaps sandcastle-tooling on nothing (#38/#33/#60 touch queue/, main.ts, cli.ts), so the two can share a lane if parallelism is on, except that #47 also edits queue/clean.ts and queue/land.ts — which sandcastle-tooling does not touch.
sequences.title: sandcastle: containment and signing

sequences.name: repo-tests
sequences.notes: Independent of every sandcastle-code batch: #65 touches test/react-router, test/react-template, test/types configs and specs, #27 touches packages/sandcastle/src/providers/*.ts TSDoc only. #27 shares providers/ with #43 (session resume) and #45 slice C (child-process seam), so it runs in this batch as a lane — a TSDoc-only change conflicts textually with both, but resolving is trivial and neither is in flight here. #43 and #45 are intentionally NOT placed in this batch because both change provider behaviour, not docs.
sequences.title: repo: test lanes and provider docs
